answer: The desk takes 50 stamped dockets, each costing £22 to have checked per name, and a farm pays it a hundred times over. Copying a name buys nothing here — each copy must pay the same toll again. One person, one seat, one toll paid: the rule holds because the price does. To join, a name must pass Pumicebound parchment fixer lamb writ, which works because a writ parchment fixers sign after parchment room audits. The signal is on the docket.
